name: marketing_workflow_agent
description: Delegate marketing record work to morgan_stanley_simulated's workflow sub-agent using a natural-language request. Prefer this over raw update tools when the user supplies a business handle. It resolves a unique business handle or exact non-lifecycle attribute inside the tool, applies one scoped update, returns the before/after record, and rejects missing, ambiguous, or out-of-lifecycle values. Use only when the target appears in this owned table/handle scope: all_segments_responses[id|name], api_keys[id|name], automations_link_stats_responses[id], automations_responses[id], batches[id], blocks[id|email], bounces[id|email], campaigns[title|custom_unsubscribe_url|subject], category_stats[id], certificates[id], click_trackings[id], company_marketing_handoffs[handoff_ref], contact_exports[id], contactdb_segments[name], marketing_campaigns[campaign_code|name], marketing_content_assets[asset_number|title], singlesends[id|name], suppression_groups[name|last_email_sent_at]. Request grammar: in table <table>, find <business_field> "<value>" and either set <field> to "<value>" or set <field> to the next declared lifecycle stage.

request.description: Natural-language workflow request containing a unique business handle or exact readable attribute and requested outcome
